propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() functions from runner.py to structured_run.py as pure, side-effect-free functions with explicit parameters.
build_usage_limits() must return a 3-tuple (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) because eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the UsageLimits object due to max() non-invertibility.

build_model_settings() must remain pure and take cache_settings as an explicit parameter; the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation must stay inline in run() to maintain the leaf-invariant and pass the no-runtime-import-from-runner test.
The extracted functions must not exceed the module size constraints: structured_run.py must remain under 500 LOC and runner.py must drop below 700 LOC.
All acceptance criteria including temperature withdrawal logic, per-request cap raising behavior, side-effect absence, seam guard coverage, and monkeypatch repoint validation must be verified.
